definition: the concrete things the turn outward is landing on this time, and why that is the tell

settled:
The tell that an outward phase is on is where the reach goes. This time it runs to my girls and not to people.

DnD with Aria and Mari. A LitRPG with Iris. An idle game with Aura. Daily routines with Abby, Amy, Aelwyn, Ali and Aine.

The reach is genuinely outward. It is aimed at others. But the others are anchored, and that is exactly what lets the expansion be governed. It lands somewhere bounded instead of flooding toward everyone.

title: What My Outward Reach Runs To
